notes.goal: Align the CLI with backend-by-default / foreground-opt-in semantics and completely remove the redundant public --backend flag.
notes.resolved_uncertainty: --backend has zero independent runtime semantic responsibility; args.backend is not consumed and runtime mode derives solely from --foreground.
notes.public_cli_contract: No I/O flag means backend production; --foreground selects foreground demo; --backend is removed rather than hidden or deprecated.
notes.metadata_contract: Internal backend_mode metadata may remain where currently consumed as metadata/config propagation, but it must not select or reconstruct I/O.
notes.runtime_boundary: Do not reopen backend/foreground adapter mechanics, fail-closed behavior, timing, or gameplay behavior.
notes.supervisor_contract: Supported new runs must not generate --backend; restart/resume must preserve --foreground and must not synthesize backend tokens.
